Container.Name: Kapowarr-SeerrNG
Container.Overview: Standalone Kapowarr comic acquisition and library management, optionally connected to SeerrNG.
Container.Description: Kapowarr runs independently and does not require SeerrNG. This companion template uses the upstream Kapowarr image. Configure its comic root and download sources, then add its API key to SeerrNG for full-volume comic requests. It is not an NG fork.
Container.Changes: Standalone optional companion template for SeerrNG.
Container.Requires: Docker and persistent appdata. Configure this app independently before connecting it to SeerrNG.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web UI Port for the standalone web interface.

Config.Name: Comics
Config.Description: Comic library root to configure in Kapowarr.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Temporary downloads shared with the configured download client.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for files created by this service.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for files created by this service.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone used by this service.
